description: This PHP class 'AgeGroup' defines a filter field used within a reporting system to filter employees based on their age groups by calculating date differences with employee birthdays. It extends a generic FilterField class and uses traits for date-time utilities. The class dynamically constructs query expressions for filtering based on age-related conditions such as less than, greater than, and between.

classes.name: AgeGroup
classes.description: A class representing an age-based filter for employee reports, allowing filtering employees by age ranges using dynamic query expressions.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Constructs and adds an age-based condition to the query builder based on operator and age parameters.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases involved in the query, in this case, 'employee'.
